intro: Down the Rabbit Hole AUST provides the green waste removal Canberra residents call when the pile in the corner has outgrown the bin and nobody wants to spend Saturday at the tip. Hedge clippings, small tree prunings, autumn leaf piles, storm-blown branches and the leftovers from a weekend of garden work all go in the trailer and leave with us. We do not stack it at the kerb, and we do not leave it for the green bin to work through a fortnight at a time.

We are fully insured, ABN registered and locally operated, Est. 2021, and you deal directly with the owner, Michael Robinson. Green waste removal is available with our mowing, garden maintenance and yard clean-up services, or as a stand-alone collection. Quotes for green waste removal Canberra wide are free and given upfront, based on what is actually there.

sections.h2: What we collect and where it goes
paras: Most loads are a mix. A typical green waste removal Canberra pick-up is the result of a big hedge cut, a couple of pruned trees and a season of leaves, all sitting in one heap behind the shed. We load it, rake the spot it was sitting on and take it away for green waste disposal rather than dumping it.

We do not take soil, rocks, treated timber or general household rubbish in a green load, because the centres will not accept them as green. If you have that sort of material as well, see our rubbish removal service and we will quote both together.
bullets: Hedge and shrub clippings, loose or bagged

paras: Send a photo of the pile with your suburb and we will quote it upfront. The main things we need to know are roughly how big the pile is, whether it includes branches thicker than your arm, and whether we can get a trailer close to it. On the day we load, cut down anything oversized, rake the area and go.

If the pile is the result of work we are already doing, such as a hedge trim or a yard clean-up, green waste removal can be added to that job's quote. Stand-alone green waste removal Canberra customers book is quoted upfront on the load and the disposal.

sections.h2: Why green bins fill so fast in Canberra
paras: Canberra's deciduous street trees drop a heavy layer of leaves through autumn across older suburbs like Ainslie, O'Connor and Lyneham, and one weekend of raking can fill a green bin three times over. In spring the growth surge means hedges in Curtin and Mawson need cutting just as the lawn is producing its biggest clippings of the year.

Then there are the storms. A summer downpour or a strong westerly through Duffy can bring down limbs that will never fit in a bin. The green waste removal Canberra households book in those weeks is mostly about getting the pile gone before it dries out or starts killing the grass underneath it.

faqs.q: Do you take green waste away or leave it on the kerb?
faqs.a: We take it with us. Nothing is left on the nature strip for a council pick-up or for you to deal with later. That applies to every green waste removal Canberra collection we do, and removal is also available with mowing, garden maintenance and yard clean-up jobs.

faqs.q: Is green waste removal Canberra wide, or only certain suburbs?
faqs.a: We cover most of Canberra and Queanbeyan. Weston Creek is our priority area, and we also collect across Woden Valley, Tuggeranong, Belconnen, the Inner North and Inner South, in suburbs such as Ainslie, O'Connor, Lyneham, Curtin, Mawson and Duffy. If your suburb is not on the list, call and ask.

faqs.q: Can you take branches from a tree I cut down myself?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as they are small enough for us to cut down and load. We take prunings and limbs from small trees and large shrubs. Whole trunks or heavy logs from a large tree are a job for an arborist with a chipper, and we will tell you if that is the case.

faqs.q: How much notice do you need for a pick-up?
faqs.a: Give as much notice as you can for green waste removal Canberra wide, as autumn and spring get busy. Send a photo of the pile and your suburb when you enquire and we will give you a quote and the next available day. Storm clean-ups are worth booking early, because the pile only gets harder to move.

faqs.q: What is the difference between this and rubbish removal?
faqs.a: Green waste is anything that grew: clippings, branches, leaves, weeds. Rubbish removal covers old pots, timber, broken furniture and household junk. They are disposed of differently, so we quote them separately, but a green waste removal Canberra visit can collect both if you have a mix.
